## Labcoat Leni 9.1

Board & Fritzon (2005): *You don't have to be 'mad' to work here, but it helps*

Do managers score higher on histrionic personality disorder than legally classified psychopaths?

- `Group`: 39 senior business managers vs. 317 legally classified psychopaths
- `Histrionic personality index`: score on the MMPI-PD histrionic scale

[Data (.jasp)](https://discoverjasp.com/repository/dsj1_data/data/board_2005.jasp) · [Results (.jasp)](https://discoverjasp.com/repository/dsj1_leni/leni_09a.jasp) · [Results (.html)](https://discoverjasp.com/repository/dsj1_leni/leni_09a.html)

## Labcoat Leni 9.2

Tuk et al. (2011): *Bladder control*

Are people with full bladders inhibited more than those without?

- `urgency`: drink all five cups of water vs. take a sip from each
- `ll_sum`: number of trials (out of 8) choosing a large, later reward over a small, sooner one

[Data (.jasp)](https://discoverjasp.com/repository/dsj1_data/data/tuk_2011.jasp) · [Results (.jasp)](https://discoverjasp.com/repository/dsj1_leni/leni_09b.jasp) · [Results (.html)](https://discoverjasp.com/repository/dsj1_leni/leni_09b.html)

## Labcoat Leni 9.3

Gelman & Weakliem (2009): *The beautiful people*

Do the most beautiful celebrities (People magazine, 1995–2000) have more daughters than sons?

- `daughters`: number of daughters, as of 2007
- `sons`: number of sons, as of 2007

[Data (.jasp)](https://discoverjasp.com/repository/dsj1_data/data/gelman_2009.jasp) · [Results (.jasp)](https://discoverjasp.com/repository/dsj1_leni/leni_09c.jasp) · [Results (.html)](https://discoverjasp.com/repository/dsj1_leni/leni_09c.html)
